author: Anna Skog
title: Mother, son found dead at home near Fennville, deputies say - NewsBreak
text:
By Anna Skog ,
9 hours ago
CLYDE TOWNSHIP, Mich. (WOOD) — A homicide investigation is underway after a woman and a juvenile male were found dead at a home near Fennville, deputies say.
Around 11:30 a.m. Wednesday, Allegan County Sheriff’s Office deputies were called to at home near 56th Street and 113th Avenue in Clyde Township, between Fennville and Pullman, for a welfare check. When no one answered the door, the deputies looked inside.
“When looking inside of a window there, they observed an unresponsive subject inside laying on a bed,” explained Lt. Mike Brown with the sheriff’s office. “They forced entry into the house, and then found two subjects deceased — one adult female and one juvenile male.”
The juvenile male, who was the one lying on the bed, was the woman’s son, he confirmed. It’s not clear how they died but their deaths are being investigated as a homicide, Brown said. The two have not yet been identified but they both were living in the home at the time, according to Brown.
Deputies investigate the deaths of two people on 56th Street in Clyde Township. (April 29, 2026) With search warrants, investigators are collecting and processing evidence and expect to be at the home for “some time,” according to Brown. Autopsies will be done on the bodies, he added.
Deputies do not have ongoing concerns for public safety, Brown said.
News 8 has a crew at the scene and is working to learn more.
